How do we
make AI go well?

SAFEAI is a student club at the University of Arizona for those who want to understand AI safety and help work on it.

Meetings every Friday at 5 PM, ECON 307

What we do this semester

General meetings

Fridays at 5 PM
ECON 307

Each week we discuss a different topic in AI safety. On many weeks, a discussion will follow a member presentation.

Next meeting: this Friday

Reading group

Interest form open

Read and discuss key AI safety texts together; an add-on to the Friday meetings.

Express interest

One-on-one guidance

Message us to set one up

Meet with our club facilitators to learn about what a career in AI safety looks like, alongside how to decide your personal path to one.

Message us on Instagram

What we talk about

Alignment

How do we get AI systems to do what we actually want?

Interpretability and evaluations

How do we see what a model is doing inside? How do we design effective tests?

Ethics and governance

How should AI be built, used, and overseen?

Research, policy, and careers

Where does AI safety work happen? How can students get involved?

Open to every major. No background needed.
